info.name: World News Extract News Geo Coordinates API

params.name: location
params.description: The location name to resolve, e.g. "Tokyo, Japan".

params.name: language
params.description: The language of the location name (ISO 6391 code).

items.docs: Resolve a free-form location name to its latitude, longitude, and canonical city name. The returned coordinates are used with the Search News `location-filter` parameter to perform local news search.
